Definition: Paseach, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Paseah or Phaseah = "limper"; 1) son of Eshton of the tribe of Judah; 2) ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 3) father of Jehoiada, one who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
